summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Applied Finance Valuation Large Cap ETF (VSLU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund the selects at least 200 US large-cap stocks based on a proprietary valuation driven investment process. VSLU was launched on Apr 29, 2021 and is issued by Applied Finance.

holdings.infoBox: VSLU is an equity ETF with a total of 460 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 11.13%, Apple at 10.43%, Microsoft at 8.01%, Alphabet at 6.85%, and Meta Platforms at 4.69%.
